pattern: relative percent growth of a yearly total, not percentage points
question: 2024 total loan amount compared to 2023 total, percentage growth
gold_sql: SELECT 100.0 * (SUM(CASE WHEN "Disbursement Date" >= '2024-01-01' AND "Disbursement Date" < '2025-01-01' THEN "Loan Amount (Rs)" ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN "Disbursement Date" >= '2023-01-01' AND "Disbursement Date" < '2024-01-01' THEN "Loan Amount (Rs)" ELSE 0 END)) / SUM(CASE WHEN "Disbursement Date" >= '2023-01-01' AND "Disbursement Date" < '2024-01-01' THEN "Loan Amount (Rs)" ELSE 0 END) AS growth_percent FROM shg_loan_register
sql_duckdb: WITH yearly_totals AS (SELECT CAST(SUBSTRING("Disbursement Date", 1, 4) AS INT) AS loan_year, SUM("Loan Amount (Rs)") AS total_amount FROM "shg_loan_register" WHERE NOT "Disbursement Date" IS NULL GROUP BY CAST(SUBSTRING("Disbursement Date", 1, 4) AS INT)) SELECT t2023.total_amount AS amount_2023, t2024.total_amount AS amount_2024, CASE WHEN t2023.total_amount IS NULL OR t2023.total_amount = 0 THEN NULL ELSE (t2024.total_amount - t2023.total_amount) * 100.0 / NULLIF(t2023.total_amount, 0) END AS percentage_growth FROM yearly_totals AS t2023 LEFT JOIN yearly_totals AS t2024 ON t2024.loan_year = 2024 WHERE t2023.loan_year = 2023

WITH yearly_totals AS (
  SELECT 
    CAST(SUBSTR("Disbursement Date", 1, 4) AS INTEGER) AS loan_year,
    SUM("Loan Amount (Rs)") AS total_amount
  FROM "shg_loan_register"
  WHERE "Disbursement Date" IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY CAST(SUBSTR("Disbursement Date", 1, 4) AS INTEGER)
)
SELECT 
  t2023.total_amount AS amount_2023,
  t2024.total_amount AS amount_2024,
  CASE 
    WHEN t2023.total_amount IS NULL OR t2023.total_amount = 0 THEN NULL
    ELSE (t2024.total_amount - t2023.total_amount) * 100.0 / t2023.total_amount
  END AS percentage_growth
FROM yearly_totals t2023
LEFT JOIN yearly_totals t2024 ON t2024.loan_year = 2024
WHERE t2023.loan_year = 2023;
